content.short: MEV Boost Dashboard provides MEV statistics across the Ethereum blockchain.
content.description: MEV Boost Dashboard is a focused analytics tool that tracks MEV-Boost relays and blockbuilders, giving users insight into who participates on the network and which actors dominate. It enables monitoring of network participation rates, Flashbot dominance, and the listing of top builders and relays. In addition, the dashboard provides an API that aggregates data across tracked relays, enabling developers to integrate the dashboard's data into their own applications and workflows.
